# Disability Rights California

> > Disability Rights California is the state's protection and advocacy agency defending the rights of people with disabilities through legal services, policy advocacy, and education.

The organization provides comprehensive resources on disability rights issues including In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS), mental health rights, Assisted Outpatient Treatment (AOT), abuse and neglect prevention, and legislative advocacy. DRC works to ensure people with disabilities have access to healthcare, personal protective equipment, legal protections, and community-based services.

## Key Topics

- Disability Rights California
- IHSS (In-Home Supportive Services)
- Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
- Assisted Outpatient Treatment (AOT)
- Mental health legal resources
- Abuse and neglect prevention
- California Department of Public Health
- AB 670 (foster youth parenting rights)
- Caregivers and healthcare workers
- COVID-19 response
- Child welfare and foster youth
- Legislative advocacy
- Community-based services
- Legal protections for people with disabilities

## In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS)

- [IHSS](https://www.disabilityrightsca.org/drc-advocacy/ihss): IHSS advocacy resources including PPE guidance for caregivers and workers

## Mental Health Rights

- [Mental Health](https://www.disabilityrightsca.org/resources/mental-health?page=1): Mental health legal resources covering AOT and disability rights issues

## Legislation and Policy

- [Abuse/Neglect](https://www.disabilityrightsca.org/legislation/abuse-neglect): Legislation on abuse/neglect including AB 670 for foster youth parents
